reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 11 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Bucks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
